description: Adds one contact, or merges tags into an existing one. Uses no send quota. ONLY add a person who agreed to receive marketing email from this business (for example they signed up, or the person you are helping confirms they opted in). If you are not sure, ask first. Addresses that unsubscribed, bounced or complained cannot be re-added. Not reversible through these tools (there is no delete tool), so check the email is right. Requires API key scope: contacts.

consent.description: Must be true. Confirms this person agreed to receive marketing email from this business. Never set it on a guess.

tags.description: Tags to add, for example ["vip"]. Merged with existing tags.

name: contacts_add
title: Add contact
